CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attendance_report(p_date date, p_institute uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_branch uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_section uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v jsonb;
begin
  if not public.is_super_admin() then
    raise exception 'Student attendance is not available for your access scope.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_date is null then
    raise exception 'Choose a date.' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  with cohort as (
    select p.id,
           p.roll_number,
           p.full_name,
           p.email,
           i.code as institute_code,
           s.year,
           b.code as branch_code,
           s.name as section_name,
           a.activity_type,
           a.marked_at,
           a.signin_log_id,
           p.is_disabled as disabled,
           -- login_allowed_for() is false for a disabled account too.
           (a.id is not null or public.login_allowed_for(p.id)) as listed
    from public.profiles p
    join public.sections s on s.id = p.section_id and s.is_active
    join public.branches b on b.id = s.branch_id
    left join public.institutes i on i.id = coalesce(s.institute_id, p.institute_id)
    left join public.attendance a on a.student_id = p.id and a.attendance_date = p_date
    where p.role = 'student'
      and coalesce(i.is_active, true)
      and (p_institute is null or coalesce(s.institute_id, p.institute_id) = p_institute)
      and (p_year is null or s.year = p_year)
      and (p_branch is null or s.branch_id = p_branch)
      and (p_section is null or s.id = p_section)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'total', count(*) filter (where c.listed),
    'present', count(c.activity_type),
    -- Students of this cohort who cannot sign in at the moment (disabled
    -- accounts are not counted here; they are off the roster altogether).
    'loginClosed', count(*) filter (where not c.listed and not c.disabled),
    'rows', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'studentId', c.id,
      'rollNumber', c.roll_number,
      'fullName', c.full_name,
      'email', c.email,
      'instituteCode', c.institute_code,
      'year', c.year,
      'branchCode', c.branch_code,
      'sectionName', c.section_name,
      'activityType', c.activity_type,
      'markedAt', c.marked_at,
      'signedInThatDay', c.signin_log_id is not null
    ) order by c.institute_code, c.year, c.branch_code, c.section_name, upper(c.roll_number) nulls last, c.email)
      filter (where c.listed), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v
  from cohort c;

  return v;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attendance_student_history(p_roll text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date;
  v_began date;
  v_session date;
  v_student record;
begin
  if not public.is_super_admin() then
    raise exception 'Student attendance is not available for your access scope.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select p.id,
         p.roll_number,
         p.full_name,
         p.email,
         p.course_start_date,
         (p.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date as created_day,
         p.is_disabled,
         i.code as institute_code,
         coalesce(s.year, p.year) as year,
         coalesce(sb.code, pb.code) as branch_code,
         s.name as section_name
    into v_student
  from public.profiles p
  left join public.sections s on s.id = p.section_id
  left join public.branches sb on sb.id = s.branch_id
  left join public.branches pb on pb.id = p.branch_id
  left join public.institutes i on i.id = coalesce(s.institute_id, p.institute_id)
  where upper(p.roll_number) = upper(btrim(coalesce(p_roll, '')))
    and p.role = 'student';

  if not found then
    return null;
  end if;

  select min(a.attendance_date) into v_began from public.attendance a;
  select y.start_date into v_session
  from public.academic_years y where y.is_active order by y.start_date desc limit 1;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'student', jsonb_build_object(
      'studentId', v_student.id,
      'rollNumber', v_student.roll_number,
      'fullName', v_student.full_name,
      'email', v_student.email,
      'instituteCode', v_student.institute_code,
      'year', v_student.year,
      'branchCode', v_student.branch_code,
      'sectionName', v_student.section_name,
      'disabled', v_student.is_disabled
    ),
    -- greatest() skips nulls; with no attendance anywhere yet there is no range.
    'from', case when v_began is null then null
                 else greatest(v_began, v_student.course_start_date, v_session, v_student.created_day) end,
    'today', v_today,
    'records', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'date', a.attendance_date,
        'activityType', a.activity_type,
        'markedAt', a.marked_at,
        'signedInThatDay', a.signin_log_id is not null
      ) order by a.attendance_date desc)
      from public.attendance a
      where a.student_id = v_student.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_profile_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select role from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()), 'none');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.faculty_can_view_student(target_student_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.class_members cm
    join public.classes c on c.id = cm.class_id
    where cm.student_id = target_student_id
      and c.faculty_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (select p.is_super_admin and p.role = 'admin' and not p.is_disabled
     from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid()),
    false);
$function$
